bio: Right on the ski slope, close to the gondola lift station, this mountain restaurant enjoys a prime location – and that, of course, means spectacular views of the peaks from the terrace. Inside, diners soak up the cosy Alpine atmosphere of the charming chalet-style decor. The establishment is run by brothers Alessandro and Sergio Grand, with the latter fulfilling chef duties, crafting modern Alpine cuisine from select ingredients. Highlights on the menu include marinated char with beetroot tartare, Horu cheese fondue, and Luma Black Angus Burger, as well as their own take on a classic apple strudel, dubbed An Apple a Day. Excellent wine selection and friendly service. Food is only served during the day, plus at two weekly evening events: Cheesy Tuesday and Schnitzel Thursday. The restaurant...
